{{Top|canon=Posting agency}}
A '''Posting Agency''' acted as an intermediary that assisted in the posting of [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], from corporations and private individuals with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It allowed private individuals to avoid dealing with Imperial [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure for a modest fee, and allowed large corporations to save on bounty registration fees. Posting agencies also dealt directly with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and passed on information about targets.
